stories.raw_title: Blockmate Ventures enters AI compute market with NVIDIA B200 GPU investment
stories.normalized_fact: Blockmate Ventures Chairman Domenic Carosa joined Steve Darling from Proactive to announce that the company has entered into a binding agreement with Scannit Inc. to acquire its first NVIDIA B200 AI compute node, marking its entry into the AI neocloud and GPU computing market. Under the agreement dated October 27, 2026, Blockmate will acquire a high-performance computing node featuring eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs for approximately US$635,000. The turnkey purchase price includes shipping, data centre setup, installation, network connectivity and onboarding. The acquisition represents a shift in Blockmate's business model as it moves from a venture builder toward becoming an owner of AI infrastructure. The company intends to generate revenue by owning specialised computing hardware and making its capacity available to AI developers and businesses through a specialist operating partner. Delivery of the initial node is currently expected in the first quarter of 2027, subject to vendor timing and NVIDIA allocation.
